record.bible_text: The word<WH01697> that came to Jeremiah<WH03414> from the LORD<WH03068>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Thus speaketh<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Write<WH03789><WTH8798> thee all the words<WH01697> that I have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> unto thee in a book<WH05612>.

For, lo, the days<WH03117> come<WH0935><WTH8802>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, that I will bring again<WH07725><WTH8804> the captivity<WH07622> of my people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478> and Judah<WH03063>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>: and I will cause them to return<WH07725><WTH8689> to the land<WH0776> that I gave<WH05414><WTH8804> to their fathers<WH01>, and they shall possess<WH03423><WTH8804> it.
And these <FI>are<Fi> the words<WH01697> that the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8765> concerning Israel<WH03478> and concerning Judah<WH03063>.

For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; We have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> a voice<WH06963> of trembling<WH02731>, of fear<WH06343>, and not of peace<WH07965>. <RF>of fear...: or, there is fear, and not peace<Rf>

Ask<WH07592><WTH8798> ye now, and see<WH07200><WTH8798> whether a man<WH02145> doth travail with child<WH03205><WTH8802>? wherefore do I see<WH07200><WTH8804> every man<WH01397> with his hands<WH03027> on his loins<WH02504>, as a woman in travail<WH03205><WTH8802>, and all faces<WH06440> are turned<WH02015><WTH8738> into paleness<WH03420>? <RF>a man: Heb. a male<Rf>

Alas<WH01945>! for that day<WH03117> <FI>is<Fi> great<WH01419>, so that<WH0369> none <FI>is<Fi> like it: it <FI>is<Fi> even the time<WH06256> of Jacob's<WH03290> trouble<WH06869>; but he shall be saved<WH03467><WTH8735> out of it.

For it shall come to pass in that day<WH03117>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, <FI>that<Fi> I will break<WH07665><WTH8799> his yoke<WH05923> from off thy neck<WH06677>, and will burst<WH05423><WTH8762> thy bonds<WH04147>, and strangers<WH02114><WTH8801> shall no more serve<WH05647><WTH8799> themselves of him:
But they shall serve<WH05647><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, and David<WH01732> their king<WH04428>, whom I will raise up<WH06965><WTH8686> unto them.<CM>

Therefore fear<WH03372><WTH8799> thou not, O my servant<WH05650> Jacob<WH03290>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>; neither be dismayed<WH02865><WTH8735>, O Israel<WH03478>: for, lo, I will save<WH03467><WTH8688> thee from afar<WH07350>, and thy seed<WH02233> from the land<WH0776> of their captivity<WH07628>; and Jacob<WH03290> shall return<WH07725><WTH8804>, and shall be in rest<WH08252><WTH8804>, and be quiet<WH07599><WTH8768>, and none shall make <FI>him<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>.

For I <FI>am<Fi> with thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>, to save<WH03467><WTH8687> thee: though I make<WH06213><WTH8799> a full end<WH03617> of all nations<WH01471> whither I have scattered<WH06327><WTH8689> thee, yet will I not make<WH06213><WTH8799> a full end<WH03617> of thee: but I will correct<WH03256><WTH8765> thee in measure<WH04941>, and will not leave thee altogether<WH05352><WTH8763> unpunished<WH05352><WTH8762>.
For thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>, Thy bruise<WH07667> <FI>is<Fi> incurable<WH0605><WTH8803>, <FI>and<Fi> thy wound<WH04347> <FI>is<Fi> grievous<WH02470><WTH8737>.

<FI> There is<Fi> none to plead<WH01777><WTH8802> thy cause<WH01779>, that thou mayest be bound up<WH04205>: thou hast no healing<WH08585> medicines<WH07499>. <RF>that...: Heb. for binding up, or, pressing<Rf>

All thy lovers<WH0157><WTH8764> have forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> thee; they seek<WH01875><WTH8799> thee not; for I have wounded<WH05221><WTH8689> thee with the wound<WH04347> of an enemy<WH0341><WTH8802>, with the chastisement<WH04148> of a cruel one<WH0394>, for the multitude<WH07230> of thine iniquity<WH05771>; <FI>because<Fi> thy sins<WH02403> were increased<WH06105><WTH8804>.

Why criest<WH02199><WTH8799> thou for thine affliction<WH07667>? thy sorrow<WH04341> <FI>is<Fi> incurable<WH0605><WTH8803> for the multitude<WH07230> of thine iniquity<WH05771>: <FI>because<Fi> thy sins<WH02403> were increased<WH06105><WTH8804>, I have done<WH06213><WTH8804> these things unto thee.

Therefore all they that devour<WH0398><WTH8802> thee shall be devoured<WH0398><WTH8735>; and all thine adversaries<WH06862>, every one of them, shall go<WH03212><WTH8799> into captivity<WH07628>; and they that spoil<WH07601><WTH8802><WTH8675><WH08154><WTH8802> thee shall be a spoil<WH04933>, and all that prey<WH0962><WTH8802> upon thee will I give<WH05414><WTH8799> for a prey<WH0957>.

For I will restore<WH05927><WTH8686> health<WH0724> unto thee, and I will heal<WH07495><WTH8799> thee of thy wounds<WH04347>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>; because they called<WH07121><WTH8804> thee an Outcast<WH05080><WTH8737>, <FI>saying<Fi> , This <FI>is<Fi> Zion<WH06726>, whom no man seeketh after<WH01875><WTH8802>.<CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>; Behold, I will bring again<WH07725><WTH8802> the captivity<WH07622> of Jacob's<WH03290> tents<WH0168>, and have mercy<WH07355><WTH8762> on his dwellingplaces<WH04908>; and the city<WH05892> shall be builded<WH01129><WTH8738> upon her own heap<WH08510>, and the palace<WH0759> shall remain<WH03427><WTH8799> after the manner<WH04941> thereof. <RF>heap: or, little hill<Rf>

And out of them shall proceed<WH03318><WTH8804> thanksgiving<WH08426> and the voice<WH06963> of them that make merry<WH07832><WTH8764>: and I will multiply<WH07235><WTH8689> them, and they shall not be few<WH04591><WTH8799>; I will also glorify<WH03513><WTH8689> them, and they shall not be small<WH06819><WTH8799>.

Their children<WH01121> also shall be as aforetime<WH06924>, and their congregation<WH05712> shall be established<WH03559><WTH8735> before<WH06440> me, and I will punish<WH06485><WTH8804> all that oppress<WH03905><WTH8801> them.

And their nobles<WH0117> shall be of themselves, and their governor<WH04910><WTH8802> shall proceed<WH03318><WTH8799> from the midst<WH07130> of them; and I will cause him to draw near<WH07126><WTH8689>, and he shall approach<WH05066><WTH8738> unto me: for who <FI>is<Fi> this that engaged<WH06148><WTH8804> his heart<WH03820> to approach<WH05066><WTH8800> unto me? saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068>.
And ye shall be my people<WH05971>, and I will be your God<WH0430>.

Behold, the whirlwind<WH05591> of the LORD<WH03068> goeth forth<WH03318><WTH8804> with fury<WH02534>, a continuing<WH01641><WTH8706> whirlwind<WH05591>: it shall fall with pain<WH02342><WTH8799> upon the head<WH07218> of the wicked<WH07563>. <RF>continuing: Heb. cutting<Rf> <RF>fall...: or, remain<Rf>

The fierce<WH02740> anger<WH0639> of the LORD<WH03068> shall not return<WH07725><WTH8799>, until he have done<WH06213><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> , and until he have performed<WH06965><WTH8687> the intents<WH04209> of his heart<WH03820>: in the latter<WH0319> days<WH03117> ye shall consider<WH0995><WTH8709> it.<CM>
